raw.oracle: Depth-1 feasible completion reward on each policy's own state, same elapsed needs drift. Not counterfactual long-horizon regret.
raw.sampling: One completed ordinary plan per agent per simulation hour; 3-minute actionSteps, hourly gaps. No social encounters, travel/ground/city cohort simulation.
raw.intervention: Seeded rain probability .2 to .8 and role-place rotation on shiftDay; no live weather or law/calendar claims.
raw.uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals over independent seed means; competence/recovery means conditional on attainment, fractions report censoring.

experiment.stress: Synthetic low initial needs, daytime load and day-shift shock; not production metabolism.
experiment.residualScope: Outcome minus decision-time expected reward; separate from raw trials/means. Same-decision MSE ablation, not a physical/LLM learning claim.
